Client req/s by endpoint
panels.description: Route template set by the scripts as the `endpoint` tag (load-test.js / stress-test.js do not set it).

panels.title: Dropped iterations/s (soak, breakpoint)
panels.description: Open-model tests only: iterations k6 could not start because every VU was still waiting for a response. Sustained drops mean the target rate is above what the service (or the load generator) can take.

panels.title: Correctness violations (contention, pagination)
panels.description: Must stay at zero. A race with no winner or several winners, or a page walk that repeats or reorders rows, is a bug - not a performance problem.

panels.title: Journey and page latency p95
panels.description: Keyset paging: deep pages should cost the same as the first one.
